term: world-relative description of the creative act
definition: A partial function d from worlds to tokens. Sound: what it denotes at a world is performed there. CoversEffect: it denotes at each accessible world with the effect. RigidAt: it denotes the same token at every accessible world. Soundness and coverage do not give rigidity.
